items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The, uh, chief David Hennessy, the police chief. It's a song. It's a song about the police chief David Hennessy.

ctx.x: The chief you mean? Say, who killed the chief?
The, uh, chief David Hennessy, the police chief. It's a song. It's a song about the police chief David Hennessy. Remember the Italians killed him? And Rabbit used to sing. The chief of police.

Yeah, Rabbit. Those police used to make that up like that. Do you remember? Yeah, I remember that. It was like when, uh, uh, uh, uh, Clem Geddes and, uh, and Morris, when the John Alden people, you know, when the Ticcuna would have made a song on him too, you know. No, I don't know about that. Tell me about it. Say, he don't know about that. Tell him. No, they used to sing it. You know them fellas like R.B. and all them fellas? They used to sing them songs, you know. But I didn't know them, you know. They used to…
